title: Trust the Process: Zero-Knowledge Machine Learning to Enhance Trust in Generative AI Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not directly measure bias in model outputs; rather, it evaluates the computational feasibility (runtime and memory overhead) of a Zero-Knowledge Machine Learning (ZKML) protocol named snarkGPT. This protocol is designed to cryptographically guarantee uniform model execution to prevent performance bias (service degradation or tier-based disparities) across different users.
